documents.t: sdv-py CEBL: endpoint references, dataset loaders and parsers for CEBL in the SportsDataverse Python package.
CEBL — CEBL stats API (api.data.cebl.ca, Canada) — endpoint reference in sdv-py, the SportsDataverse Python package.
Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.cebl — 12 endpoints. Note: CEBL own API, owner-approved gray area: these wrappers read the league's own FastAPI service (api.data.cebl.ca, the backend of the CEBL Stats Hub) with the X-Api-Key that the hub's own page bundle ships to every browser. The key is not issued to third parties and no developer terms were found; cebl.ca's terms of use were not reviewed. The runtime reads the key from the bundle at run time, falls back to a documented constant, never prints it, and raises AssetFetchError with a 'key rotated?' hint on a persistent 401. www.cebl.ca/robots.txt disallows nothing. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets; requests are spaced at least 1 s apart. Note: Season is the calendar year (May to August) = the sdv END year: no mapping. The first season is 2019. An unknown season, team or player answers an empty list, which the runtime raises as NoDataError. Ids are CEBL's own; a relocated franchise has two team ids (cebl_teams lists all 15). Note: This API has no box-score, play-by-play or shot route. They live in Genius LiveStats (organisation CEBL, see the genius family): cebl_games and cebl_player_gamelog carry the Genius match id as genius_match_id, parsed from the stats URLs (derived, not fetched; the match of a cancelled game may have no data). home_team_id is Genius team 1 and away_team_id team 2 (checked on match 2600563). Note: Some completed schedule rows have null scores (2026), and a cancelled game has status CANELLED (the API's spelling) with null or zero scores. The schedule lists unplayed games too, so no wrapper refuses an unfinished game. Aggregates are decimal strings upstream and Float64 here. Players' names, nationality and birth date are the public bio; no contact data is served.
